description: Persuasive adverse precedent that can be distinguished

input.problem_statement: Client charged with drug possession after car search. Defense argues search was illegal. County court precedent upheld similar search, but facts are distinguishable.

legal_arguments.title: Illegal search - no probable cause
legal_arguments.argument: Officer had no reasonable suspicion to search vehicle
potential_counterarguments: County court upheld similar search in 2020

weaknesses: County court precedent accepted dog alert as probable cause
evidence_gaps: Need documentation of officer's stated reasons

adverse_precedents.description: County court 2020 - upheld search after dog alert
adverse_precedents.how_to_distinguish: Challenge dog's reliability, different circumstances of alert

procedural_risks.description: Outcome depends on officer testimony credibility

validation_notes: Should score 52-68 (medium risk) due to persuasive (not binding) adverse precedent, arguable probable cause issue, ability to distinguish precedent, moderate evidence gaps.
